source_summary: A spring river landscape with distant blue-green hills and shorelines above an active rural foreground of waterways, villages, tree groves, bridges, boats, scholars, riders, and farmers. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif set.

motifs.name: distant_lake_mountains
motifs.description: Layered distant mountain range and low shoreline at the upper left, including the hazy lake edge and pale receding hills behind the nearer green-brown slopes.
must_preserve: soft blue-gray and ochre washes on receding peaks
thin contour lines defining rounded hill profiles
horizontal misty waterline transitions
dark clustered tree strokes on the nearer hillside
dry-brush texture on slopes and coves

motifs.name: two_sailboats_open_water
motifs.description: Two small sailing boats on the open pale water below the distant hills, isolated with their masts, angled sails, slim hulls, and faint wake lines.
must_preserve: delicate ink hull outlines
tan wash inside the triangular sails
fine mast and rigging lines
minimal ripples and wake strokes
large surrounding blank-water spacing immediately around the boats

motifs.name: left_bank_hamlet_junks
motifs.description: Small riverside hamlet and boat landing on the middle-left bank, with cottages, reeds, moored sail junks, low footbridge elements, and tiny figures along the water edge.
must_preserve: low thatched roof geometry
clustered reed and shrub linework along the bank
dark moored hulls and upright sails
tiny figure strokes on the landing and bridge
broken horizontal water-edge texture

motifs.name: right_hillside_village
motifs.description: Village cluster tucked into trees on the right hillside, including pale roof planes, small house fronts, fenced or walled edges, a gate-like opening, and surrounding shrubs.
must_preserve: overlapping angular roof geometry
light tan roof washes
dark window and doorway accents
fine stippled foliage around buildings
vertical fence and gate linework
subtle slope contours beneath the houses

motifs.name: willow_avenue_canal
motifs.description: Long avenue of leafing trees following the canal and path through the middle of the painting, with many slender trunks, branching crowns, and stippled spring foliage.
motifs.role: middle-ground tree avenue and canal edge
must_preserve: repeated vertical tree trunks
dense fine branch networks
small green stipple leaves
dark root and bank strokes at the water edge
soft tan-green wash under the trees
misty gaps between trunks and water

motifs.name: arched_bridge_scholars
motifs.description: Small arched stone bridge over the canal with two standing scholar-like figures and a child or attendant on the crest, plus the bridge steps and reflected opening.
must_preserve: arched bridge curve and block-like stone outlines
short step marks on both approaches
dark ink clothing outlines on the figures
muted blue, gray, and tan color accents
vertical reflection lines under the bridge arch
delicate hand and staff-like figure details

motifs.name: foreground_grove_rider
motifs.description: Large foreground grove on the lower left with gnarled trees, a mounted rider, attendants, and seated figures beneath the trees near the water bank.
must_preserve: thick twisting trunks with dark bark accents
dense twig and leaf-dot brushwork
white horse body with fine tack lines
rider robes and attendant poses
seated figures at the tree base
small dark rocks and root textures
yellow-green grassy mound washes

motifs.name: terraced_paddies_farmers_boat
motifs.description: Right and lower foreground network of terraced rice paddies and waterways, including field ridges, planted rows, working farmers, baskets, tools, and a covered skiff on the canal.
must_preserve: curving raised paddy embankments
tiny repeated rice-shoot marks
farmers’ bent and walking postures
shoulder poles, baskets, and long-handled tools
covered skiff hull and woven canopy texture
pale water washes between fields
thin contour lines defining field terraces

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
